subject: Money
title: How Income Tax Works
description: A 60-second lesson on How Income Tax Works.

hook.text: You earn $50,000 in the U.S. Your tax isn't 22% of all of it. Tax brackets stack, they don't replace.

buildup.text: The first $11,000 is taxed at 10%. The next chunk at 12%. Only what exceeds each threshold moves up.

discovery.text: This is marginal taxation. Your effective rate is always lower than your top bracket rate.

twist.text: Many people turn down raises fearing a higher bracket. They don't realize only the extra dollars move up.

climax.text: Understanding brackets is worth thousands. The math is simple but the misconception costs real money.

punchline.text: A raise never costs more than it pays.

quiz.question: In a marginal tax system, what happens when you enter a higher bracket?
options: All your income is taxed at the higher rate
Only the income above the threshold is taxed higher
